name: Save The Hawkins
summary:
Enter the mysterious town of Hawkins in this immersive VR horror survival experience .
A dark dimension has begun spreading across the town, opening terrifying portals and unleashing deadly creatures into the real world. Armed with VR weapons and your survival instincts, you must fight horrifying enemies, explore dangerous environments, and protect Hawkins before the invasion consumes everything.
Experience intense VR combat, cinematic horror atmosphere, dynamic enemy encounters.

!! IT'S CODE RED !!
